brief: A Signal K plugin that switches a boat's MikroTik router to an allowlist while the internet is metered (Starlink pay-per-GB), and shows where the data goes. Used by skippers and crew on phones and chart-side tablets, day and night watch.
criteria: Success: reads at 16 px, works in one colour and red on black at night, avoids security clichés (shields, padlocks, walls, flames), and means something to people on boats.

concepts.name: Valve
concepts.idea: A boat's through-hull valve (seacock), turned part-way open: the crew decides how much flows.
rationale: A control every sailor knows: open or shut by choice, which is what the plugin does to the router
Turned 45 degrees, part-way open, it says metered without drawing a speedometer
Ring, lever and pivot on one 256 grid, one stroke weight; a heavier cut for 16 to 24 px
The lever carries the colour: the part the crew controls

recommendation: Valve: the chosen direction, refined into masters, colour, lockups and icons.
next_steps: Use the header symbol, favicon and Signal K app icon in the plugin
Trademark search before publishing to the Signal K appstore
Optional: draw a custom wordmark instead of DejaVu Sans Bold
